data.body: **[P1] Keep PR-controlled workflows off account runners.** A `pull_request` uses the PR's workflow definition, so a fork can edit this routing expression—or the gates at `check-spotless.yml:37`, `conformance-tests.yml:42/59`, and `e2e-tests.yml:45`—to request the known CodeBuild label. Dependabot PRs also already select CodeBuild because their head repository is the base repository. This allows untrusted code to execute with the runner's AWS role and account network access. Keep all `pull_request` jobs on GitHub-hosted runners, or dispatch verified same-repository, non-bot heads from a base-controlled workflow such as `pull_request_target`/`workflow_run`.
